desc: Pampered Poodle: a puffy white cartoon poodle with round pompom fur, a pink bow on its head, nose stuck up in the air, floating beside the ogre's head like a little charm. Bold dark outlines, chunky simple toy-like shapes, painterly - NOT realistic, no fur detail

Pocket Watch Chain: a chunky gold watch chain worn across the chest, hooked to a button and looping down, a big round gold pocket watch dangling from it with its lid open. Bold dark outlines, chunky simple shapes, painterly - NOT realistic

Service Bell: a chunky polished brass service bell worn on top of the head as a hat, a cartoon 'ding' sparkle of three short lines above it. Bold dark outlines, chunky simple toy-like shapes, painterly - NOT realistic

Lucky Ball: a chunky white dimpled golf ball floating beside the ogre's head like a little charm, a small golden lucky sparkle on it and a red tee spinning under it. Bold dark outlines, chunky simple toy-like shapes, painterly - NOT realistic

Course Gopher: a chubby cartoon brown gopher with big buck teeth and a cheeky grin, hugging a stolen white golf ball, floating beside the ogre's head like a little charm. Bold dark outlines, chunky simple toy-like shapes, painterly - NOT realistic, no fur detail
